# GameLogicTests/GalaxyAnswers.txt
#
# The galaxies' known answers (D33): every system of all eight galaxies, 2,048 answers, as the game's own routines
# describe it. They were recorded from the native code while every state digest of the corpus and every twin answer still
# met the original's, and GalaxyAnswerTests checks them.
#
# How a system is described: galaxyNumber set to its galaxy and the galactic chart chosen, its seeds loaded
# (Elite::LoadSystemSeeds), and from them its record and its name (Elite::DescribeSystem, the part of SelectSystemAtCursor
# after the search). Then the chart's cursor is put on its place (Elite::MoveCursorToSystem) and the system there selected
# (Elite::SelectSystemAtCursor), as the status and data screens select one.
#
# Format: one system per line, in order of galaxy and then system, twelve fields separated by single spaces, all decimal
# but the name:
#
#   GALAXY SYSTEM NAME X Y ECONOMY GOVERNMENT TECH POPULATION PRODUCTIVITY RADIUS SELECTED
#
#   GALAXY        0-7, galaxyNumber
#   SYSTEM        0-255, its index in the galaxy
#   NAME          selectedSystemName, selectedSystemNameLength characters
#   X, Y          its place: systemX and systemY, the high bytes of its seeds; the chart shows Y halved
#   ECONOMY       selectedEconomy
#   GOVERNMENT    selectedGovernment
#   TECH          selectedTechLevel, shown one more
#   POPULATION    selectedPopulationTenthsBillion
#   PRODUCTIVITY  selectedProductivityMillionCredits
#   RADIUS        selectedRadiusKm
#   SELECTED      the system the cursor selects on its place, selectedSystemIndex: the system itself, or an earlier one of
#                 the galaxy at the same X and halved Y, which the search finds first
#
# Lave is system 7 of galaxy 0: "0 7 LAVE 20 173 2 3 5 28 13552 6276 7". Its economy, 2, is Rich Agricultural in this
# build's names (economyNames counts from Poor Agricultural), and its government, 3, a Dictatorship, as published for the
# BBC Micro (plan §6.4). Its tech level, population, productivity and radius are this build's own: not the BBC Micro's
# published tech level 5, 2.5 billion, 7000 M CR and 4116 km.
#
# Checking: a line that differs fails, naming it and both texts, and so does a count other than 2,048. Recording: with
# OUTPOST_ELITE_RECORD_GUARD set, in one process and never in CI, the test writes the answers instead, keeping this header.
#
